info.title: Growth API
info.description: The Growth backend. Every success body is wrapped in `data`, and every error has a `message` and a `requestId`. Signed-in endpoints read the session cookie that Better Auth sets.

servers.description: Local backend. The frontend proxies /api to it.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Sign up, sign in and the session. Better Auth serves every path under /api/auth. Only the paths the frontend uses are listed here.

tags.name: Course content
tags.description: Reference data and code snippets. Public.

tags.name: Learning path
tags.description: The units and lessons, with the learner's progress.

tags.name: Lessons
tags.description: Open a lesson, keep a note and mark it started.

tags.name: Tests
tags.description: Lesson tests, checkpoints and the final challenge. An attempt holds up to 5 questions chosen when it starts. The correct answer is only sent after the learner answers.

post.description: Creates the account and signs the learner in. A default profile is created with it. The response body is defined by Better Auth.

200.description: Account created. The session cookie is set.

400.description: The email is already used, or a field is invalid.

post.description: The request must come from the origin in BETTER_AUTH_URL, or Better Auth rejects it with INVALID_ORIGIN. The response body is defined by Better Auth.

200.description: Signed in. The session cookie is set.
Signed out. The session cookie is cleared.

get.description: Returns null when nobody is signed in.
The language is `language` if it is given. If not, it is the signed-in learner's code language, and pseudocode when they have none or nobody is signed in.

200.description: The source and the line of each step.

patch.description: Send only the fields that change.

200.description: The learner and the updated profile.

get.description: The current lesson is the first one the learner has not completed. Completed lessons and the current lesson are open, every other lesson is locked.
A locked lesson returns 403. A missing or retired lesson returns 404.
Returns an empty body and a null `updatedAt` when there is no note yet.

put.description: Creates the note the first time and updates it after that. Returns 400 over 2000 characters, or for a lesson with no notes step.

post.description: Starts a lesson test, or a checkpoint test for a checkpoint. Locked lessons can be tested, so a learner can test out of them. If the learner already has an unfinished attempt for the lesson, that one is returned with 200. Two starts at the same moment make one attempt. A lesson with no questions returns 409.

200.description: The unfinished attempt that was already there.

201.description: A new attempt and its first question.

get.description: Use it to pick up after a reload. An attempt in progress returns its current question with the hints already unlocked. A finished attempt returns its result. Another learner's attempt returns 404.

200.description: The attempt with a question or a result.

post.description: Each hint lowers the score for that answer. Returns 409 when the question is not the current one, is already answered, has no hints left, or the attempt is finished.

Grades the answer, updates the learner's rating for the question's lesson and returns the correct answer and the explanation. After the last answer, `question` is null and `result` is set. A pass completes the lesson and every lesson before it. The answer type must match the question type. A question id that is not in the attempt returns 404. A question that is already answered, is not the current one, or an attempt that is finished returns 409.

200.description: The feedback, and the next question or the result.

sessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
sessionCookie.description: Set by sign in and sign up.

BadRequest.description: The request is invalid. The body has `issues` when it failed validation.

Forbidden.description: Signed in, but not allowed. For a lesson, it is locked.

NotFound.description: It does not exist, or it belongs to someone else.

Conflict.description: The request clashes with the current state.
